notes: One rule, from the one signal with a known shape: OpenCode's terminal title is `OC | <session>`, with a braille spinner glyph in front while a turn runs (the shape Orca matches). Nothing on the screen body is trusted yet — no rule has been watched against a live session, and borrowing Claude's bottom-of-screen patterns is how a spinner under a question reads as work. Everything the title does not say is `unknown`, which the sidebar shows honestly, until a soak produces patterns of OpenCode's own.

rules.note: OpenCode puts one spinner glyph before its `OC |` title while a turn runs; nothing typed into the composer reaches the title.
